    tidybiotek: Tidy Tools for Applied Biotechnology Bioinformatics

    Source: R/tidybiotek-package.R
    tidybiotek-package.Rd

    tidybiotek brings applied biotechnology bioinformatics into the tidyverse and tidymodels. Every user-facing function takes a data frame first, uses tidy evaluation for column arguments and returns a tibble or a tibble subclass, so analyses read as pipelines.

    Details

    The package is organised into modules:

    • Sequences: bio_seq_tbl(), bio_translate(), bio_gc_content(), bio_codon_weights(), bio_cai(), bio_codon_optimise(), bio_primer_tm(), bio_kmer_count() and bio_aa_props().

    • Assays: bio_qpcr_ddct(), bio_dose_response() and bio_elisa_quant().

    • Bioprocess: bio_enzyme_kinetics() and bio_monod_growth().

    • Omics: bio_diff_expr() and bio_enrich().

    • tidymodels: step_bio_kmers(), step_bio_aa_props(), step_bio_vst_norm(), bio_homology_cv(), bio_batch_cv(), enrichment_factor(), bedroc(), assay_cv_error() and bio_four_pl().

    • Reporting: tidy(), glance(), augment() and autoplot() methods.

    All numerical methods (codon adaptation, nearest-neighbour thermodynamics, Levenberg-Marquardt four-parameter logistic fitting, the exact integrated solution of Monod kinetics and empirical Bayes variance moderation) are written in base R and stats.
